capability: Label every join; fold only the ones that agree
title: Fold only the joins that agree.

hook.picture: Close on the whale holding two answer cards from two pods. It drops both on the line; the second lands on top and the first vanishes under it.
hook.words: We asked two agents. The merge kept one.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Two agents disagreed, and the merge just kept the last one.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer reading a merged multi-agent report

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three more pod pairs drop cards. Each time the later card covers the earlier one: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Last one in wins. Every single time.

stakes.body: A disagreement between agents is erased without a trace, so the team ships an answer that another agent had already contradicted.

solution_hint: Check each join. Keep only what agrees.

metaphor.body: Each agent's answer is a card on the line. Where two cards meet is a join. Only joins that agree rise into a gold trunk; the rest stay visible below.

steps.picture: Where two cards meet, a dashed join mark appears. The whale taps one: the two card edges are compared, they match, the mark turns teal with a tick.
steps.words: Check each join before anything is kept.
steps.sound: Two plucks land in unison on the tick.

steps.picture: At the next join the edges do not match. The mark glows terracotta, and both cards stay on the line, side by side. Nothing is erased.
steps.words: Each place they meet is a seam.
steps.sound: Two plucks held apart, both ringing.

steps.picture: Push-in. The teal joins lift their cards up into a thick gold trunk line above. The terracotta pair stays below, still visible.
steps.sound: A rising two-note fold, in tune.

steps.picture: Small chips on four joins: ok, strange, broken, missing. Only the ok chip's cards rise to the trunk.
steps.words: Only agreeing joins fold into the trunk.
steps.sound: One tuned pluck per chip, only ok resolves.

real_case.claim: The cell-sheaf-swarm contract gives every edge a status in {ok, strange, broken, missing}; only ok folds into the trunk, strange only after a person.

honest_limit.picture: Two pods arrive with cards that both carry the same copper smudge inside. Their edges match, the join turns teal, and the smudged pair rises into the trunk.
honest_limit.words: Two wrong answers can still agree.

not_this.body: Agreement is not the same as true.

ending_pattern.body: The FELT handover replays. Both disagreeing cards stay visible at a terracotta join while the agreeing joins fold into a gold trunk above.
ending_pattern.callback: The card that vanished under its rival in bar 2 now sits beside it, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Check every join. Keep disagreements in sight.

beats.picture: Close on the whale. Two pods swim in and hand it two answer cards that say different things (one teal tab, one copper tab).
beats.words: We asked two agents. The merge kept one.
beats.sound: Two plucks, a quarter-tone apart.

beats.picture: The whale drops both on the line. The copper card lands on top and the teal card vanishes under it. A faint empty outline is left.
beats.sound: A dull thud cuts the first pluck off.

beats.picture: A third pod reads the line, acts on the surviving card, and answers with a copper ✕ chip.
beats.words: Nobody saw the two answers fight.
beats.sound: The surviving pluck goes sour.

beats.picture: The whale looks back at the empty outline where the teal card was. Hold.
beats.sound: Silence creeps in.

beats.picture: Half a bar of stillness, then SERIES.open and the title.
beats.sound: Near-silence, then the title tick.
beats.camera: still (half a bar of stillness first)

beats.picture: Pull back. The line is long, and at every join one card is buried under another. Ghost outlines everywhere.
beats.sound: Room tone, then the problem motif once.

beats.picture: Three more pod pairs drop cards. Each time the later card covers the earlier one: every 2 beats, then 1, then a half.
beats.words: Last one in wins. Every single time.
beats.sound: Problem motif three times, accelerating.

beats.picture: Everything stops. At each buried join the two cards lift apart slightly, side by side.
beats.words: Check each join. Keep only what agrees.
beats.sound: The first clean signature: two plucks in unison.

beats.picture: Where two cards meet, a dashed join mark appears. The whale taps one: the two card edges are compared, they match, the mark turns teal with a tick.
beats.words: Check each join before anything is kept.
beats.sound: Two plucks land in unison on the tick.

beats.picture: At the next join the edges do not match. The mark glows terracotta, and both cards stay on the line, side by side. Nothing is erased.
beats.words: Each place they meet is a seam.
beats.sound: Two plucks held apart, both ringing.

beats.picture: Push-in. The teal joins lift their cards up into a thick gold trunk line above. The terracotta pair stays below, still visible.
beats.sound: A rising two-note fold, in tune.

beats.picture: Small chips on four joins: ok, strange, broken, missing. Only the ok chip's cards rise to the trunk.
beats.words: Only agreeing joins fold into the trunk.
beats.sound: One tuned pluck per chip, only ok resolves.

beats.picture: Wide. The swarm contract: a row of agent cards, a chip on every join, a gold trunk fed only by ok joins. The card fades in on clean paper.
beats.words: Real rule: only ok joins fold in.
beats.sound: Pulse bed, quiet ticks on each ok.

beats.picture: A strange join (cards fit, but one is oddly sized) is set on a short side branch next to an empty person chip. It waits.
beats.words: Odd joins wait for a person.
beats.sound: A held note that does not resolve yet.

beats.picture: Two pods arrive with cards that both carry the same copper smudge inside. Their edges match, the join turns teal, and the smudged pair rises into the trunk.
beats.words: Two wrong answers can still agree.
beats.sound: The signature plays once and stays unresolved.

beats.picture: Slow push into the smudge, now sitting in the gold trunk.
beats.words: Agreement is not the same as true.
beats.sound: Room tone.
beats.camera: one slow push to the thing that slipped

beats.picture: Same close framing as bar 1. The same two pods hand over the same two different cards. They land side by side at a terracotta join. Neither vanishes.
beats.sound: The two plucks ring together, both heard.

beats.picture: The teal joins along the line fold into the trunk. The whale lights up with delight and a spark.
beats.sound: Full resolution on the trunk.

beats.picture: The trunk above, both cards still visible below, the whale breathing.
beats.words: Check every join. Keep disagreements in sight.
beats.sound: Pad tail.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled chart ground.
beats.sound: Lockup sting, then the room tone tail.

score_self.reason: Problem and move read from pictures: buried card, then cards kept side by side. The case is a real rule, not a run, so CASE is thinner than LONGFORM wants. Limit uses the cluster trap well.
